findings: Parent UART CLKDIV handler uses fixed40MHz and ignores the S3 clock-selection contract.
TX drains bytes immediately through the QEMU chardev; no per-character transmit deadline.
RX throttles only at full128-byte FIFO; short ASIC replies do not prove character timing.
S3 subclass delegates CLKDIV to the parent. Existing baud_rate field alone is not an accurate S3 timing oracle.
